mapper.sql: select w.id, w.work_no, w.batch_no, w.service_fee, w.currency, w.verify_cycle, w.order_status, w.finish_date, w.remark, w.del_flag, w.create_by, w.create_time from br_work_order w
mapper.select: where w.del_flag = '0' AND w.work_no like concat('%', #{workNo}, '%') AND w.batch_no like concat('%', #{batchNo}, '%') AND w.order_status = #{orderStatus} order by w.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into br_work_order (work_no, batch_no, service_fee, currency, verify_cycle, order_status, finish_date, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{workNo}, #{batchNo}, #{serviceFee}, #{currency}, #{verifyCycle}, '01', #{finishDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_work_order set order_status = #{orderStatus} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update br_work_order set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select i.id, i.work_order_id, i.material_id, m.material_name, i.plan_qty from br_work_order_item i left join br_material m on m.id = i.material_id where i.work_order_id = #{workOrderId}
mapper.insert: insert into br_work_order_item (work_order_id, material_id, plan_qty) values (#{workOrderId}, #{materialId}, #{planQty})
mapper.select: select i.material_id, sum(i.issue_qty) as plan_qty from br_issue_item i join br_issue h on h.id = i.issue_id and h.del_flag = '0' join br_material m on m.id = i.material_id and m.mark_type = '1' where h.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} group by i.material_id

select ifnull(sum(i.issue_qty), 0) from br_issue_item i join br_issue h on h.id = i.issue_id and h.del_flag = '0' and h.doc_status in ('03', '05') join br_work_order w on w.id = h.work_order_id join br_material m on m.id = i.material_id where w.work_no = #{workNo} and m.mark_type = '1'

select ifnull(sum(t.material_num), 0) from br_receive_item t join br_receive h on h.id = t.receive_id and h.del_flag = '0' and h.doc_status in ('03', '05') join br_work_order w on w.id = h.work_order_id where w.work_no = #{workNo} and t.return_type in ('5', 'a')

select ifnull(sum(t.material_num), 0) from br_receive_item t join br_receive h on h.id = t.receive_id and h.del_flag = '0' and h.doc_status in ('03', '05') join br_work_order w on w.id = h.work_order_id where w.work_no = #{workNo} and t.return_type = '1'

select ifnull(sum(t.material_num), 0) from br_receive_item t join br_receive h on h.id = t.receive_id and h.del_flag = '0' and h.doc_status in ('03', '05') join br_work_order w on w.id = h.work_order_id where w.work_no = #{workNo} and t.return_type in ('5', 'a', '1', '7', '8', '9')

select ifnull(sum(i.delivery_cnt), 0) from br_outbound_item i join br_outbound h on h.id = i.outbound_id and h.del_flag = '0' and h.doc_status in ('03', '05') where i.goods_source_type = 'i' and i.goods_source_no in ( select h2.receive_no from br_receive h2 join br_work_order w2 on w2.id = h2.work_order_id where w2.work_no = #{workNo} and h2.del_flag = '0')
select work_order_id from br_receive where receive_no = #{receiveNo} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
